name: SurveySparrow
summary: Conversational surveys and NPS with a polished respondent experience. Response limits on the lower tiers and a contact-sales wall on API and higher volume make budgeting fiddly, and there is no true monthly billing.
best_for: teams that want engaging, conversational surveys and NPS with a polished respondent experience
skip_if: you just need a quick, occasional form: a free tool like Google Forms or Tally covers it without a subscription
honest_knock: The conversational-survey UX is the draw, but response limits on lower tiers and the 'contact sales' wall on advanced features (API, higher volume) make budgeting fiddly, and there's no true monthly billing.

pricing.notes:
(re-read 26 November 2026 from a European server, so in euros; the dollar page was not re-read) On 26 November the yearly Starter and Business cards carry a SALE price: Starter €26 against a struck-through €39 and Business €52 against a struck-through €79, which works out at 33% and 34% off. Basic stays €19 on yearly billing, the quarterly prices stay €39, €59 and €149, and the response allowances and users are unchanged. The page gives no end date for the sale, and the 'up to 40%' wording for yearly billing is no longer on it. (re-verified 20 September 2026 from a US exit in New York; the euro ladder was read 14 September 2026 from Europe) SurveySparrow bills quarterly or yearly — there is no monthly option — and the two differ far more than the wording suggests. On yearly billing the survey line runs Basic $19, Starter $39 and Business $79 a month, above a forever-free plan (75 responses a quarter, 3 active surveys, 10 questions each) and below a custom-priced Enterprise tier. On quarterly billing those same three plans are $39, $59 and $149 a month — roughly double — and they carry fewer responses a year rather than more: Basic goes from 2,500 a year to 600 a quarter, Starter from 15,000 to 3,600, while Business's 9,000 a quarter matches its 36,000. Users are 1, 1 and 3 respectively, with extra users $49 each a month.

The currency question is settled. Read from New York the page shows the identical digits with a dollar sign, so a European is quoted €19/€39/€79 where an American is quoted $19/$39/$79. That is the same number rather than a conversion, which makes the euro ladder the dearer of the two in real terms. There are separate product lines for CX, brand, research, documents and 360 assessment, each with its own ladder. Discounts (September reading): yearly saves up to 40%, students and education 50%, nonprofits 15%, and a startup programme offers $2,000 of credit for $500.

exit_test.what: We created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 15 November 2026 the session tested SurveySparrow on a brand new account that started as an expired trial: the choice screen, the free plan response limit, one survey with one response, the export options and the price per plan up to the card form. Nothing was paid or downloaded. A survey called My First Survey already existed (created through Start Blank). One Rating question was added. Question types marked with a crown (paid): Upload, Matrix, Bipolar Matrix, Rank Order, Group Rank, Constant Sum, Payment, Signature, Heatmap, Group Rating, Record Audio and Thank You Page. A second text question was not saved, which was an error in our input, so the survey had 1 question. Distribute gave a share link. Web Link and Embed are free and the email channel has no crown; WhatsApp, QR, Facebook and X have a crown. One own response was filled in (4 stars). After Thank you for your time! the respondent was sent on to a SurveySparrow advertising page (Join 100,000+ customers), with our account name in the web address; the exact name is not recorded here. The counter then read 1/75 and the survey showed 1 response and a completion rate of 100%. The time from logging in at 17:06 to the first collected response at 17:09 was about 3 minutes. Export: Results, Downloads, Responses offers CSV and XLSX without a crown and SPSS with a crown (paid); Overview can go out as PDF or PPTX. Nothing was downloaded. Cancelling: there is nothing to cancel on the free plan. Billing and Settings show no button to delete the account (not searched further); deleting the account is a step for the account owner and was not tested. Not tested: the Business trial (never received), Extend trial by 5 days, sending email, logic, AI surveys and Echo Agents, integrations, downloading a file and the second question. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: A new account opened on Trial expired and blocked the work until a plan or an extension was chosen; going to Free needs a required reason. The free plan sends respondents to a SurveySparrow advertising page with our account name in the address.
